base_direction: D — Orange Top / White Field / Blue Circulation

refinements.product_orientation: 100% product / 0% sales; opening view is immediately usable rather than a marketing landing page
refinements.title: FAE Web Interface; Mobile Preview remains in the bottom section

topper.status: single status chip in orange topper

ticker.typography: preserve the earlier compact ticker font and sizing
ticker.content: Block Height / Supply / Reward / Difficulty; avoid redundant large metric cards

mode_controls.placement: small Wallet and Mining buttons at upper-right in the white zone below the ticker
mode_controls.semantics: focused separated modes; Wallet shows wallet content, Mining shows mining content

mining_overview.purpose: useful mining telemetry that does not duplicate ticker data

devices.icons: preserve the earlier simpler device icon family

bars.geometry: small thin rectangular battery-like bars, centered inside the Devices box
bars.size: approximately 20% smaller/thinner than the previous authoritative candidate
bars.spacing: larger vertical separation and generous blank internal whitespace for visual cleanliness
bars.current_value: current works/s inside the blue fill
bars.max_value: estimated maximum works/s fixed at the right side inside the track
bars.intensity: strong electric blue near estimated maximum; progressively lighter blue below capacity
bars.motion: fast live internal motion proportional to work execution; bar fill dynamically falls/rises with actual works
bars.semantics: performance relative to each device's own estimated focused-mining ceiling, never deterministic progress to reward

refinements.mobile: show focused Wallet and Mining smartphone previews in the bottom section

non_authority_effects: does not authorize public rebrand deployment
does not authorize merge to main
does not authorize Explorer source writes
does not finalize logo or symbol
